annotation.justification: The clause is clear in its requirement that a TCP implementation supporting multiple concurrent users must provide an OPEN call that allows an application to LISTEN on a port while a connection block with the same local port is in SYN-SENT or SYN-RECEIVED state. There is no ambiguity in the wording or in the required behavior.
